{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Heavy wool trench coat in a classic straight cut reaching mid-calf, color #2f352e (dark charcoal) made of thick water-resistant gabardine fabric.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers with a relaxed fit falling to the ankle, color #4a5d6a (muted slate blue) crafted from structured cotton twill for durability against wind and rain.
Soft white knit blouse with a subtle mock neck and long sleeves, color #f5f5f0 (off-white) made of fine merino wool blend to add warmth under the coat.
Polished leather ankle boots on a low block heel in a rounded toe shape, color #2e2b35 (deep espresso brown) constructed from smooth grain leather for grip on wet pavement.
Leather belt in a thin rectangular buckle matching the boot color, color #2e2b35 crafted from supple calfskin to cinch the waist without restricting movement.

This outfit works perfectly for an autumn day in the rain because the trench coat provides essential protection from the elements while maintaining a professional appearance for meeting a client. The wide-leg trousers and block-heeled ankle boots offer stability on wet, slippery surfaces while ensuring you stay comfortable during a long coffee conversation. The neutral color palette of charcoal, slate, and deep brown reflects the autumn season and pairs seamlessly with your natural skin tones, creating a polished yet understated look suitable for work."}
